summary.tldr: Requires the finance minister to create a cash access framework, report on it, and bars the Bank of Canada from issuing a digital dollar.
what_it_does: Requires the Minister of Finance to review laws, rules, and policies on cash access within 90 days of the bill coming into force.
Requires the minister to develop and implement a framework to keep cash available across Canada.
Requires the framework to support cash withdrawals and deposits, continued use of cash by people and businesses, cash donations to non-profit and community groups, and long-term cash infrastructure.
Requires the minister to table a report on the framework within 18 months, then publish it online within 10 days after it has been tabled in both Houses of Parliament.
Requires a later review of the framework’s implementation, effectiveness, and social and economic impacts within three years after the first report is tabled.
Repeals the Governor in Council’s power to call in coins and notes, and prohibits the Bank of Canada from issuing a digital form of the dollar.
